title: UniversalArpTable
description: Universal ARP table schema for mikomai and configuration management

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the ARP table was generated

source_device.description: The hostname or device name from which the ARP table was retrieved

os_type.description: The operating system or device type, e.g., macos, windows, linux, cisco_ios, junos, routeros, etc.

ip_address.description: The IP address of the ARP entry

mac_address.description: The MAC address of the ARP entry in standard colon-separated lowercase format

type.description: The type of the ARP entry (dynamic, static, incomplete, permanent)

interface.description: The network interface associated with the ARP entry

age_seconds.description: Optional age or time-to-live of the ARP entry in seconds
